title: The open repo's tracy builder connects to a Tracy account with the OAuth device flow and builds a demo with one press, without a second demo after a timeout
steps: S1: A fake Tracy on a local port. A connection asks for a device code, polls (pending, slow_down, then allowed; also denied; also expired), then reads /v1/me.
S2: The access token expires; five calls run at once. Then the grant is revoked in Tracy and a call runs. Then Disconnect.
S3: The standalone app with TRACY_URL at the fake: the operator connects on /operator/tracy; Build it with Tracy on a saved place; the tick follows the demo to ready.
S4: The fake stalls POST /v1/demos past the client timeout, then the tick runs; the fake answers 409 DEMO_LIMIT_REACHED; 503 SPONSOR_BUDGET_EXHAUSTED; a cancel.
expect: S1: the page sees the user code and link but never a token or device code; slow_down adds 5 s before the next poll; denied and expired end with error access_denied / expired_token; the token file has mode 0600.

S2: exactly one refresh for the five calls, the rotated pair written before use; revoked → state reconnect with no token kept; disconnect posts the refresh token to /oauth/revoke and deletes the file.

S3: the request body is website-opportunities/demo-request/v1 with the business name and location; a second press answers the same demo; ready → demo url, editUrl, expiresAt on GET /:id, the row in the Outreach stage with a draft carrying the link.
S4: one demo only after the timeout (same Idempotency-Key and bytes); 409 with live and limit kept on the demo as refused; 503 surfaced; cancel reaches Tracy.
evidence: Before: builders/tracy.js was a planned stub that threw BUILDER_PLANNED; the place page only linked to tracy.ai
fence: the request row (exact body + idempotency key) is written before POST /v1/demos; refresh is single-flight and saved atomically; invalid_grant on refresh → reconnect

tests: connect shows a code and a link
slow_down makes the next poll wait five seconds longer
a denied code ends the flow
an expired code ends the flow
many calls that find the token expired share ONE refresh
a grant revoked in Tracy turns the connection to Reconnect
disconnect revokes the grant in Tracy
Build it with Tracy sends the place, then the tick follows the demo to ready
a timeout never makes a second demo
the live demo limit comes back with its numbers
Build: the live demo limit names both numbers
